Ramayana Cast on KBC 18: Big B’s Diwali Story Steals the Show

28 Oct 2026, 07:29 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

Image: ABP Live Entertainment — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysRamayana stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey appear in a KBC 18 festive promo. Its standout moment is Amitabh Bachchan recalling a childhood firecracker rivalry with neighbours.

Star-Studded Festive Preview

Actors Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravie Dubey are shown in a promo for 'Kaun Banega Crorepati 18' to promote Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming cinematic adaptation of the Ramayana. During the Diwali special episode, host Amitabh Bachchan shared childhood anecdotes, joking about a competitive 'firecracker rivalry' with his neighbors, which entertained the guest stars.

Project Outlook

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the high-budget production features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita. The film is planned as a two-part event, with the first installment scheduled for theatrical release on November 5, 2026, and the second installment expected to follow in 2027. The source lists a 9 PM Sony Entertainment Television slot; check the broadcaster for the exact episode date. Who appears in the KBC Ramayana special?

The promo features Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey alongside host Amitabh Bachchan. ABP Live’s October 24 report describes a promotional clip, so the clip should not be confused with confirmation of a full episode’s streaming availability.

When and where can viewers watch?

ABP Live lists Sony Entertainment Television and a 9 PM slot for the festive episodes. Check Sony’s current programme listing for the exact broadcast date and any replay availability.
